text.en:
Last time you said where someone is.
Now you say where they are not.
Je suis ici. = I am here.
Je ne suis pas ici. = I am not here.
Ne and pas are new. Together they mean “not”.
Tu n’es pas là. = You’re not there.

title.en: Ne and pas hug the middle word

text.en:
Ne goes before the am/are/is word.
Pas goes right after it.
Je ne suis pas ici. Ne, then suis, then pas.
Elle n’est pas là. = She is not there.
Elle means “she”. Est means “is”.
Before est or es, ne becomes n’. It joins the next word.

Now you build phrases with “not”.
Start with who: Je, Tu, Elle.
Put ne (or n’) next, then the middle word, then pas.
Last, add the place.
Example: Paul n’est pas au bureau.
= Paul is not in the office.
